notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: אַתְּ long ves em i pronon 'yu' (lemma אתה), i no aleph-tav marker H853

notes.subject: ami i kotim ol plak
notes.rationale: נדגלות: 'ol ami long ol plak' (dual/plural bilong דגל), o samting i save fainim aut wantaim plak — ol i.no save stret

notes.subject: כתרצה/כנדגלות
notes.rationale: Tupela komparesen i stat wantaim כ — Tri-taim 'olsem' stat long wanwan lain, pasin bilong song

translation: Yu gutpela tru, meri bilong lav bilong mi, olsem Tirtsa; yu swit olsem Yerusalayim; yu i mekim man fright olsem ol ami i kotim ol plak.

tokens.gloss: olsem ol ami i kotim ol plak
